The legend distinguishes rivers, railways, expressways, and city symbols of different levels; Zhengzhou City is located in a relatively central position in the figure and is represented by the symbol of a provincial capital city. The figure also marks surrounding cities such as Luoyang City, Kaifeng City, Xinxiang City, Jiaozuo City, Xuchang City, Pingdingshan City, Luohe City, Jiyuan City, etc.; their level symbols are lower than Zhengzhou. Then reason: The material explains that “the Central Plains urban agglomeration takes Zhengzhou as the center and Luoyang as the sub-center,” and the transportation network has also basically formed a pattern centered on Zhengzhou. The higher the city level, the larger the service range usually is; Zhengzhou is the central city and the highest-level provincial capital city, so the city with the largest service range in the Central Plains urban agglomeration is Zhengzhou.
